notes.title: Chapter 4 Completed!
notes.notes:
Greetings from Fapno Island!

We've been hard at work cranking away... AT THE GAME! *Ahem* Chapter 4 in now completed and available to play for our [url=patreon.com/FapYeahGames]Patreons[/url] and on our [url=https://fapyeah.itch.io/nofapisland]itch.io[/url]. If you can't take the edging we're putting you through, go ahead and try the game in it's current state.

Work continues as we advance towards the juicier parts of the story. Stay tuned for more updates fellow gooner.

notes.title: Languages Added: Simplified Chinese and Russian
notes.notes:
New language options have been added to the Demo. You can now enjoy the game in Simplified Chinese and Russian. There could be a possibility that more languages get added. These take a lot of work so for now, I'll play things by ear and see how these do.
The game is also progressing nicely, I can't wait for you all to experience the fun and saucy scenes I have cooking.

notes.title: Development Update - 6th Oct
notes.notes:
Hello you magnificent gamers,
Thanks for your interest in our game, No Fap Island. We have just released our first playable demo which you can find on the store page. If you are interested in what's more to come, I'll let you in on the secret: the game is planned to be 6 chapters long, each encompassing a day on the island. We have a lot of spicy stuff cooking and can't wait to share more in the future.
If you'd like to follow the game's progress more regularly, please check out [url=https://www.patreon.com/FapYeahGames]our Patreon[/url] for more in depth reports.


Team FapYeah
